text: Here is the argument in five steps. One: marriage is an institution. Two: it benefits men by setting limits on desire. Three: unlike cohabitation, it supplies a template. Four: it is a form of social capital. Five: normative marriage has six dimensions. Learn these five and you can answer any question on the essay.
